text:
maria (PM): Hey all — I pasted the company OKR draft for next quarter into the doc (link in thread). Need alignment + sign-off by EOD Thursday so we can push to the board pack.

ravi (Head, Eng): skimmed. Good structure. Two immediate asks: 1) tighten the latency SLO from 99.9% -> 99.95% only if we commit extra infra $; 2) clarify backup plan for Dedicated capacity if we hit throughput spikes.

derek (VP Product): on the Dedicated SLO — proposal in doc: fallback routing to hosted pool with throttles and cost budget guardrails. That keeps customer UX up while limiting cost exposure.

jamie (Growth): from GTM side we need a clear launch criteria for Redwood Private (VPC). Customers asked for KMS + audit logs and an SSO story. Can we mark those as must-have?

maria (PM): noted. Draft launch criteria now includes: `KMS integrated`, `audit logs enabled`, `SSO via SAML/OIDC`, and `supportability runbook + 24h on-call` as minimum. If any of those slip, marketing holds launch.

elaine (CEO): agree with marketing gating KMS/SSO/audit. Also want a topline # for ARR motion tied to Private: target $600k ARR commitment from pilot customers within 90 days post-launch. Is that realistic?

derek (VP Product): $600k is aggressive. Recommend `pilot commitments` metric instead: 3 pilot customers with signed POCs + expected ARR estimate, then escalate to $ target for GA.

ravi (Head, Eng): engineering constraints: to hit the SSO + KMS + audit timeline we need to deprioritize one Q deliverable — either `advanced batching optimizations` or `model quantization guidelines`. Which is higher value?

maria (PM): customer asks favor quantization guidance (reduces cost for many customers). Batching yields infra savings but less customer-visible. I'll propose moving batching to Q after next.

jamie (Growth): ok if we move batching, but we need to reflect that in the OKRs: change "cost/unit" KR to include both `quantization playbook` + `default quantized model on hosted catalog` instead of infra batching.

ops-bot: Incident report summary uploaded for last week's Dedicated outage — root cause: autoscaler misconfig + insufficient burn-in tests. Link: https://redwood.internal/incident/IR-2026-03-11

ravi (Head, Eng): that incident also affects reliability KR. Suggest we add a KR: `Reduce Dedicated outage minutes by 80% vs last quarter` and `rollback runbooks coverage 100%` to be explicit.

elaine (CEO): good. Also add a leadership KR around cross-functional readiness: `Sales + Success enablement docs complete` and `2 enablement sessions` pre-GA.

maria (PM): updated the doc: added the KR lines, moved batching out, added pilot commitments metric. Also added a proposed rollout timeline: `canary -> limited GA (5 customers) -> GA` with gating checks at each step.

derek (VP Product): can we surface risks & mitigation concisely in the doc? e.g. "KMS delay" => mitigation = feature flag + partial key escrow with customer approval.

maria (PM): done — added a Risks table and owner tags.

jamie (Growth): quick note on measurement: we need `northstar events` for Private: `private_deployments_live` and `private_monthly_active_customers`. Add these as tracking KRs.

ravi (Head, Eng): prioritization note: if an enterprise security customer pays for earlier delivery, we can accelerate KMS/SSO work. We should accept scoped POCs. Recommend KR: `2 paid POCs for Private within 60 days` so we can trade scope vs revenue.

elaine (CEO): I like that tradeoff. Add that as an explicit KR. Also want org-level cadence: weekly exec OKR check-ins on Wednesdays.

maria (PM): it's in the doc. Last item: sign-off process — I need VP/CEO signoff in-thread by Thu EOD. If no objections, I'll publish the OKRs to the company Friday.

derek (VP Product): Reviewed — approve from Product. :thumbsup:

ravi (Head, Eng): Approve from Eng, with caveat we re-evaluate batching deprioritization after 6 weeks if infra cost spikes.

jamie (Growth): Approve from Growth. Will coordinate enablement sessions. :partyparrot:

elaine (CEO): Approve. Two asks from me: 1) include a one-pager for the board summarizing the Private go-to-market risks; 2) add a KR for customer quality regressions tied to evals (`no+3% model regression on core prompts`).

maria (PM): added both items. Thanks — will send final doc link and publish Friday morning.

ops-bot: Reminder: board pack deadline is Friday 09:00 PT.

elaine (CEO): Great. Sign-off complete. Let's run the weekly exec check-ins starting next Wed.

maria (PM): thanks everyone — closing thread and will publish the company OKRs on Friday. :white_check_mark:
